_comment: Public roadmap milestones (decision 0012). Plain language for backers and customers. Each milestone lists the project-board items behind it: roadmap numbers (docs/roadmap.md) and exact issue titles. Only the status and the count of done items are published, never item titles. 'status' overrides the computed status for work that is not on the board; 'target' is shown only when set, and only the owner sets it.

products.name: EVCore Studio
products.tagline: Diagnosis records and customer reports for repair shops. Available now as a beta.

products.name: Studio Pro
products.tagline: Studio working with the EVCore D1: tests run by the device, results straight into the job.

products.name: EVCore D1
products.tagline: The bench diagnostic device for e-bikes, e-motos and scooters. In development.

milestones.title: Studio beta for repair shops
milestones.summary: Work orders, customers and their bikes, manual diagnoses with readings checked against their range, and PDF reports for customers. Records stay on the shop's computer with daily backups.

milestones.title: Bug reports and feature requests
milestones.summary: Customers report problems and ask for features on the website and follow our answers there.

milestones.title: Guided demo and onboarding
milestones.summary: A two-minute guided demo in the browser, and a welcome checklist that takes a new shop to its first customer report.

milestones.title: Signed Windows installer
milestones.summary: A code-signed installer, so Windows no longer warns when you install Studio.
issues: Code signing: certificate profile, signing app and a signed release

milestones.title: Vehicle and component library
milestones.summary: Connectors, components and error codes, each marked with how well it is established and where it came from.

milestones.title: Clearer reports
milestones.summary: Reports that separate what was measured, what was expected, what was found and what is recommended, with how sure each finding is.

milestones.title: Accessibility and complete help
milestones.summary: Keyboard and screen-reader support throughout, and help pages for every workflow.

milestones.title: Learning from the field
milestones.summary: New failure modes that shops find feed back into the library, with where they came from.

milestones.title: Guided device workflow
milestones.summary: Connect the D1 over USB and follow a guided job from identifying the vehicle to the report, with the device's safety state always shown.

milestones.title: Live data and bus explorer
milestones.summary: Live charts from the device and a view of real CAN and serial traffic, plus calibration and adapter management.

milestones.title: Firmware foundation and safety design
milestones.summary: The firmware structure, the safety requirements and hazard analysis, and the automated checks every change must pass.

milestones.title: Diagnostic tests, proven in simulation
milestones.summary: Motor, controller, battery, sensor and harness tests, developed and tested against a simulated device before they run on hardware.

milestones.title: Device and Studio talking together
milestones.summary: The connection between the D1 and Studio: capabilities, progress, live readings and safe updates of test data.

milestones.title: First hardware: board bring-up
milestones.summary: Final hardware decisions, then bringing up the board step by step: safety supervisor and STOP first, then outputs, USB, measurements and the vehicle buses.

milestones.title: Bench validation
milestones.summary: Every test checked against known-good and known-faulty parts, with a rig that reruns the whole suite on a real board.

milestones.title: Ready for production
milestones.summary: Safe firmware updates, a manufacturing self-test and calibration station, pre-compliance testing and a pilot with repair shops.
